name: Carpio (Spain)
description: Square flag with a horizontal tricolour of green, white and red, the white charged with the crowned arms of Carpio (a castle on red above flames).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 22 March 2005 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 27 May 2005; the flag is a square cloth of proportion 1:1 divided horizontally into three equal parts, green above, red below and white in the centre, the latter charged with the municipal arms in their colours.

features.role: Carpio arms — castle on red above flames on white
